title: MSC, then Maersk, Hapag-Lloyd and CMA CGM reroute around the Cape to avoid Red Sea attacks
reason: Rerouting bunches Asia schedules and shifts some cargo west, but transpacific lanes are untouched.

title: Drought forces Panama Canal to slash transits further
reason: Canal limits divert some East Coast-bound Asian cargo to LA/Long Beach, a slow indirect push.

title: Port of Los Angeles reports near-record January: 855,652 TEU, +18% y/y
reason: Near-record January volume means more ship calls competing for the same berths.

title: LA and Long Beach report strong February volumes after Lunar New Year
reason: Post-Lunar New Year lull means fewer arrivals in March, which eases the queue.

title: Port of Los Angeles April cargo: 770,337 TEU, +12% y/y
reason: Steady double-digit growth adds calls, but no sign of berth congestion.

title: Port of Los Angeles May cargo: 752,893 TEU, about 3% below May 2023
reason: A soft month with fewer calls lowers pressure on the anchorage.

title: Port of Los Angeles June cargo: 827,757 TEU; first half up 14%
reason: Volume rebound adds calls; a modest upward push.

title: Panama Canal eases draft and raises daily transits to 35
reason: Canal easing pulls some cargo back to the East Coast, slightly reducing West Coast calls.

title: Port of Los Angeles: best July in 116 years, 939,600 TEU, +37% y/y
reason: Early peak season brings the busiest month in two years, straining berth capacity.

title: Port of Los Angeles August: 960,597 TEU, busiest non-pandemic month; Long Beach sets all-time record
reason: Record volumes at both ports raise the chance ships wait for a berth.

title: Section 301 tariff increases on Chinese goods take effect
reason: Tariff deadline front-loads Chinese imports, a short burst of extra arrivals.

title: ILA strike shuts 36 East and Gulf Coast ports
reason: East and Gulf Coast strike diverts some cargo west, adding arrivals at San Pedro Bay.

title: Port of Los Angeles record October: 905,026 TEU, 'without a single ship backed up at sea'
reason: Record volume, but the port says no ship waited at sea, so the queue stays small.

title: Trump promises 25% tariffs on Mexico and Canada and +10% on China
reason: Tariff threat encourages importers to front-load shipments into December and January.

title: Port of Los Angeles November: 884,315 TEU, +16% y/y; Long Beach best November
reason: Strong November volumes keep berths busy heading into the tariff front-loading period.
